'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Pistone DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Pistone]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Name as written on the Day 2 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
